en-US.longDescription: KSudoku is a free version of the popular logic game Sudoku developed by the KDE community. The game is to fill a nine by nine grid with the numbers from one to nine filling the rows, columns and three by three squares without repeating a value on them.
en-US.name: ksudoku

zh-CN.longDescription: KSudoku 是由 KDE 社区开发的自由版本的数独——一种流行的逻辑游戏。游戏需要用一到九的数字不重复地填满九乘九的格子。
